supported_workflows: Evaluation of medical reasoning over PubMed abstracts
supported_questions: Do mitochondria play a role in remodelling lace plant leaves during programmed cell death?
Is drug X effective for condition Y based on published evidence?
Does the reported study support the hypothesis?

overlap_with.nature: Both are medical; pubmedqa_eval focuses on research-abstract QA while clinical_guidelines focuses on synthesised practice recommendations

weak_content: Questions are framed as yes/no/maybe over single abstracts; less useful for open-ended clinical consultation
Some abstracts are basic-science (e.g., plant PCD) and only weakly relevant to clinical medicine
primary_recommendation: Use as the standard medical QA evaluation set. For clinical decision-support RAG, prefer medical_clinical_guidelines.
